instructions_to_main_agent: 1. In `frontend/src/index.css`, import the 3 fonts (@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans, @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono) and configure the dark navy theme variables accurately.
2. Ensure the `<html class='dark'>` in `frontend/index.html` is set by default or active class on container.
3. Build full responsive support: hamburger menu on mobile for Navbar with smooth sheet or drawer overlay, rich desktop nav.

4. Implement all pages with rich interactive details: Home, Programs, ProgramDetail (dynamically handles the 5 programs with detailed syllabus, career roles, tools, and prerequisites), Roadmaps (with visual step timeline), Projects (filterable by category: AI/ML, GenAI, Data Analytics), JobReady (6-step detailed guide, resume tips, interview prep checklists), About, Contact (with working form + feedback toast), Register (3-step wizard with validation), RegistrationSuccess, and Admin dashboard.

5. In Admin dashboard, provide summary stats cards, Recharts chart for registrations by program & timeline, search/filter controls, and a complete table with status dropdown updating (New, Contacted, Enrolled, In Review) and quick note addition with backend persistence.

6. In Backend (`backend/server.py` or routers), provide API endpoints for: POST /api/leads (registration & advisor requests), GET /api/leads (with filters), PATCH /api/leads/{id} (status & notes), GET /api/stats (aggregate metrics), and GET /api/programs (program metadata). Provide sample seed data in `backend/seed.py` so the admin dashboard is immediately populated with realistic leads and stats.
7. Include all `data-testid` tags as specified to guarantee reliable end-to-end verification.
8. Implement rotating quotes in the Hero section with smooth auto-cycling every 4 seconds and manual dot controls.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_tone: Premium, career-accelerating technology consultancy. Deep obsidian & navy background with electric cyan/sky accents and subtle crystal glass elements. Sharp precision cards with 1px border glows.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_patterns: No overly saturated purple gradients, no childish illustrations, no generic centered white cards on gray, no unreadable low-contrast text.
